intro: The Department offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes. Programme names, codes and core subjects below are taken from the IIT Kharagpur ERP curriculum pages.

programmes.name: B.Tech in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
programmes.summary: The four-year B.Tech programme builds from mathematics, physics, chemistry and engineering fundamentals into materials thermodynamics and kinetics, engineering materials and scientific computing for materials science.

programmes.name: Double Major options
programmes.summary: Double Major in Process Metallurgy (DM_MT), Double Major in Advanced Materials (DM_MT1) and Double Major in Materials Engineering (DM_MT2).

programmes.name: Combined programmes
programmes.summary: Metallurgical and Materials Engineering / Financial Engineering (MTJ) and Metallurgical and Materials Engineering / Engineering Entrepreneurship (MTK).

programmes.name: M.Tech in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
programmes.summary: Core subjects include thermodynamics of engineering materials, metallurgical kinetics, principles and techniques of materials characterisation, and programming and numerical methods in materials engineering.

programmes.name: M.Tech in Steel Technology
programmes.summary: A postgraduate specialisation in steel technology. The full subject list is published on the IIT Kharagpur ERP curriculum page.

programmes.name: Ph.D. programme
programmes.summary: Doctoral research under the supervision of department faculty across all six research areas. IIT Kharagpur runs a rolling Ph.D. admission process.

admissions.title: Undergraduate admission
admissions.text: Admission to the B.Tech programme is through JEE (Advanced) and joint seat allocation, as for all IIT undergraduate programmes.

admissions.title: Postgraduate admission
admissions.text: M.Tech admission details, eligibility and schedules are published by IIT Kharagpur each year.

admissions.title: Ph.D. admission
admissions.text: IIT Kharagpur accepts Ph.D. applications through its rolling admission process.
